lines.en: I'm small, but I drift fast.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面滑，衣角拖出一道线。
lines.en: I skim the ground, hem drawing a line.

lines.zh: 每走三步，我就换一次方向。
lines.en: Every three steps, I change direction.
Ki holds my feet, so my steps never land.
I slip between the stones.
I duck under the beam.
I loop once around the pillar.

lines.zh: 我飘到你头顶，再降下来。
lines.en: I drift above your head, then drop.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边看你在哪。
lines.en: I walk and keep track of you.
There's a lot of ki in this small body.

lines.zh: 我连着闪了两下，位置换了。
lines.en: Two quick flickers and I've moved.

lines.zh: 我落在地上，又立刻浮起。
lines.en: I touch down, then lift off again.

lines.zh: 我的第三只眼还没睁开。
lines.en: My third eye is still shut.
Ki coils between my fingers.
I'm counting how many steps you have left.

lines.zh: 这小个头，是我暂时的样子。
lines.en: This small shape is only temporary.
Head tilted, I smile at you.

lines.zh: 我打哈欠，气从嘴里散开。
lines.en: I yawn and ki spills from my mouth.
I never land, so I never tire.

lines.zh: 这地方的天花板有点低。
lines.en: The ceiling here is a little low.
I raise a hand and my fingertip glows.

lines.zh: 我的斗篷在无风的地方也在动。
lines.en: My cloak moves even without wind.

lines.zh: 我在想，要不要现在就变。
lines.en: I'm deciding whether to change now.
You haven't made me serious yet.
I count slowly to ten.

lines.zh: 你低头看我，我不喜欢这个角度。
lines.en: You look down at me. I dislike the angle.

lines.zh: 我浮起来一点，跟你平视。
lines.en: I rise a little to meet your eyes.

lines.zh: 这么小的个子，你也敢站着？
lines.en: Even at this size, you still stand your ground?

lines.zh: 我笑了，你不知道我在笑什么。
lines.en: I smile, and you don't know why.

lines.zh: 你的气，我一眼就量出来了。
lines.en: I measured your ki at a glance.

lines.zh: 我打量你的鞋，你的手，你的腰。
lines.en: I note your boots, your hands, your waist.

lines.zh: 你看我的眼睛，别看我后面。
lines.en: Watch my eyes, not behind me.
I turn and come around to your flank.

lines.zh: 我这副样子，很容易被看轻。
lines.en: This form is easy to underestimate.
You'll regret that.
I lift my chin and smile.
Your gear is good. A pity.

lines.zh: 我说话很轻，你听清了吗？
lines.en: I speak softly. Did you catch that?
Don't rush. I have other forms.

lines.zh: 你站得笔直，像在等判决。
lines.en: You stand straight, as if awaiting sentence.
Then keep looking, for now.
I'm knocked into a spin.
That scattered my ki.
I grit my teeth and rise again.
My hem is torn. I don't care.

lines.zh: 这具小身子，撑不了几下。
lines.en: This small body can't take many of these.
My third eye throbs.
You hit me. Not bad.
Keep this up, and I'll have to change.

lines.zh: 你这点吃的，我一口就够。
lines.en: One bite is all I need from that.
I'm hungry, but I'm not in a hurry.
Can such small hands hold it steady?
I'll eat. I won't thank you.

lines.zh: 我伸手一勾，东西就飞来了。
lines.en: I crook a finger and it flies to me.
I can eat and fight at once.

lines.zh: 你别靠太近，我脾气不好。
lines.en: Don't come too close; my temper is short.

lines.zh: 吃完这口，你就是下一个。
lines.en: After this bite, you're next.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我从你头顶滑过去。
lines.en: You charge; I slide over your head.
My ki flares and you're thrown back.

lines.zh: 这么小的身子，也不怕撞。
lines.en: Small as I am, I don't mind a bump.
I drift back a little, smiling.

lines.zh: 你撞空了，我早换了位置。
lines.en: You hit empty air; I'd already moved.

lines.zh: 我脚下不稳，落回了地面。
lines.en: I lose my balance and drop to the ground.
Easy. Bumping won't settle anything.
I put a hand out and push you back.
Try that again.
Not in this form.
I look at it; it looks at me.

lines.zh: 我们隔着一道气，谁也没靠近。
lines.en: A layer of ki separates us.
I smile once and turn away.
The king's business waits for the king.

lines.zh: 气碰了一下，就算打过招呼。
lines.en: Our ki touches once. That's the greeting.
This place isn't suitable.
Another time, perhaps.
I look toward the distant door.

lines.zh: 我勾了勾手指，它飘起来。
lines.en: I crook a finger and it floats up.
Ki holds it steadier than hands.

lines.zh: 我把它转了两圈，看清楚了。
lines.en: I turn it twice and understand it.
It crumbles at a touch. Useless.

lines.zh: 掉下去的东西，我懒得捡。
lines.en: I can't be bothered to pick up what falls.
It'll make a good toy.

lines.zh: 把这颗仙豆捡起来，我留着。
lines.en: I'll pick up this senzu bean and keep it.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的东西，都算我的。
lines.en: Anything on the ground is mine now.
You raised a hand. Let's begin.
I rise to your eye level.

lines.zh: 我浮起来，跟你眼睛齐平。
lines.en: I rise until I'm level with your eyes.
I'll test one shot first.
Your weight is too far forward.
This one is just a greeting.
My third eye is burning.

lines.zh: 别以为个子小就好对付。
lines.en: Don't think small means easy.

lines.zh: 我笑了一下，气焰升起来。
lines.en: I smile and my aura rises.
You're inside my range.

lines.zh: 从这一步起，你躲不掉了。
lines.en: From this step, you can't dodge.

lines.zh: 我们之间的距离，我算过了。
lines.en: I've measured the distance.
First I pin your left side.
Don't make me transform again.
One flicker and I'm behind you.

lines.zh: 你的攻击擦过我的衣角。
lines.en: Your attack grazes my hem.

lines.zh: 我往上一升，你的视线跟丢了。
lines.en: I rise and you lose sight of me.
A string of ki blasts chases you.
Your footwork is breaking down.
I pause on purpose.
And you charge, as expected.
I slip aside and you overshoot.

lines.zh: 小个子有小个子的打法。
lines.en: Small bodies fight a certain way.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面飞，你打不中。
lines.en: I fly low; you can't hit me.
Ki gathers in my hand.

lines.zh: 你的护甲挡不住第二次。
lines.en: Your armor won't take a second.
I go up and you look up.
I drop, and you're too slow.

lines.zh: 这一带的天花板，我摸清了。
lines.en: I've learned this ceiling.

lines.zh: 小个子掠着地飞，你的剑够不到。
lines.en: A small one skims the ground — your sword can't reach me.
Before it ends, I want to play a little.
I kick your wrist.

lines.zh: 气弹贴着你的胸口炸开。
lines.en: A ki blast bursts against your chest.
I dart in and strike three times.
This palm shove sends you back.

lines.zh: 我从上方落下来，砸在你肩上。
lines.en: I drop from above onto your shoulder.

lines.zh: 气功波擦着地面推过去。
lines.en: A ki wave skims the floor.

lines.zh: 我挡开你的剑，反手一推。
lines.en: I turn your blade aside and push back.
Small, but the blow is heavy.
Ki bursts in my palm.
I pull back with a laugh.

lines.zh: 我踮脚跳起，气弹先出手。
lines.en: I spring up and the ki blast leaves my palm first.
This one is the ki barrier.
I squeeze out through the crack of the door.
This body is smaller than I expected.
I float up and look around.
Ki spreads beneath my feet.
I still know the smell of the Demon Realm.
I raise a hand and test my strength.
These hands can crush stone.
The ceiling is too low. I don't like it.
But there's living ki here.

lines.zh: 我咧嘴笑了笑，第三只眼还闭着。
lines.en: I grin; my third eye stays shut.
My third eye starts to burn.
Not yet.
I pull my ki back in.
Let's see how long you all last.
I drift forward, hem stirring the air.

lines.zh: 这地方，我迟早要坐上去。
lines.en: Sooner or later, I'll take this place.
For now, let's play.

lines.zh: 火苗舔到衣角，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Flames lick my hem; I swat twice.
I hit the ground and my ki scatters.

lines.zh: 水灌进我嘴里，气提不上来。
lines.en: Water fills my mouth; I can't gather ki.

lines.zh: 气浪把我这小身子掀翻。
lines.en: The shockwave flips my little body over.
An arrow sticks in my shoulder.
Light locks my ki and I can't move.
This body burns food fast, and my ki fades.

lines.zh: 雷劈在我身上，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Lightning hits and I jolt.
I fall, and my ki can't hold me.
